item.title: “Gunfighter Paradise” Screening + Q&A with Jethro Waters ’13 — Fri Oct 23, 7:00 PM
item.description:
Join us for a screening of “Gunfighter Paradise,” written and directed by Emmy Award-winning UNC Asheville alum Jethro Waters ’13. Set in North Carolina, the independent film follows a hunter who returns home after his mother’s death and encounters mysterious visitors, unsettling visions, and a reality that begins to unravel. Following the screening in the Blue Ridge Room of Highsmith Student Union, Waters will join the audience for a Q&A about the film and his work as a filmmaker. The event is free and open to the public. Learn more and watch the trailer at Gunfighter Paradise. Accessibility UNC Asheville is committed to providing universal access to all of our events. If you have any questions about access or would like to request reasonable accommodations that will facilitate your full participation in the film screenings, please contact Stephanie Bullick, Director of Accessibility, at accessibility@unca.edu. item.title: Walk Connemara (Carl Sandburg's Home) and the Village of Flat Rock — Sat Oct 24, 9:30 AM
item.description:
Haywood County Walking Meetup Group Spend time on the treelined trails walked by Carl Sandburg. Walk around a lake, past his home, by the goat barn, and over the rock where Sandburg often wrote his poetry. Then walk a short distance to visit the quaint shops of the village of Flat Rock. Go by the rock for which the village is named and past the Flat Rock Playhouse (the official NC State Playhouse).
The trees are changing colors. There are several views of beautiful Fall panoramas. You can stop and watch the baby goats play as their mothers watch on.
We will be walking with the Asheville Amblers Walking Club, AARP, Strider, and perhaps some others. We will register in the back parking lot at **Quality Inn & Suites Hendersonville - Flat Rock, 111 Commercial Blvd., Flat Rock NC 28731**, at the I-26 exit 53 (next to Cracker Barrel). item.description:

item.title: Peace of Mind — Wed Oct 28, 7:00 PM
item.description:
Meditation in Asheville: Meditation and Modern Buddhism Peace of Mind with Modern Buddhism Teacher Kadam Sharon Lovich Peace is the foundation of our happiness and the good news is this potential for peace already exists within our own mind. In this relaxing series we will explore a variety of simple and practical meditations that will help us slow down, let go of stress and connect with our natural capacity for peace, happiness and a positive outlook. Each class focuses on a different meditation that you can easily bring into your daily life giving you practical tools to create a calmer and happier way of living. Everyone is welcome - no meditation experience required. Cost: $12 (free and online options for members) [Read More and Register](https://www.meditationinasheville.org/wednesday-drop-in-meditation-class-asheville-nc/) [Become a Member](https://www.meditationinasheville.org/become-a-member/)

item.title: Weekly Critique — Wed Nov 11, 6:00 PM
item.description:
AVL Writers This is the standing weekly critique. Bring anything new you're working on to share with the group. If you don't have a project to share, you are most welcome to attend, discuss, and get inspired.
For our group discussion, please bring at least 8-10 printed copies of your piece. That way, we can all read through each other's work and provide feedback.
Sharing our creative efforts is an important part of the writing process. I'm really looking forward to reading what you've been working on. Don't worry if it's still a rough draft.
If you're having trouble finding us, look for a placard on the table with the group's name.
If you would like to join our group email list for updates regarding contests, events, and more [you can sign up on our website](https://avlwriters.com/).
Source: AVL Writers

**Show your work. Share your process. Get better together!**
AVL UX is back for Event 3!
Join Asheville's UX and product community for an evening focused on **portfolio feedback, professional development, and networking.**
## **Portfolio Review**
Bring your portfolio, case study, or work in progress on your laptop, tablet, or phone.
Experienced professionals from UX, design, research, and product will be available to provide feedback on:
* Portfolio storytelling and case studies * UX process and design decisions * Visual presentation and structure * Problem framing and communication

item.title: J. Plank — Fri Dec 11, 8:30 PM
item.description:
J. Plank (Jeff Plankenhorn) is a BC-based, internationally touring singer-songwriter and master of the lap steel guitar. Known for soulful vocals, dynamic stagecraft, and a sound that bridges roots, blues, and folk, he has spent decades captivating audiences across North America, Europe, and Japan. Plank is a highly respected musician recognized for his skill as a slide guitarist, songwriter, and vocalist, gaining acclaim both as a solo artist and as a sought-after session player. His style blends blues, folk, and roots into a sound that’s uniquely his own.
In 2025, he released The Bend, a stripped-down solo acoustic album recorded on the Texas coast, showcasing just his voice, lap steel, acoustic guitar, and piano. Later this year he will follow it with a high-energy roots rock album recorded in the Netherlands with the band The Southern Aces — a project that blends live-off-the-floor energy with wizardly guitar playing, innovative songwriting, and, most of all, deep groove.
